# Human Atlas integration

Source: https://github.com/ashemag/human-atlas
Pinned commit: `1c38bf35c254a891200d3cedecfd57abebe83d8d`

Original MIT application code and BodyParts3D assets/CC BY 4.0 attribution are preserved.
Med-AI adaptations: same-origin base paths, a validated parent-window selection bridge, disabled optional WebMCP tools, and an isolated build with only imported dependencies. The original viewer interface, geometry, layer/search/explode/camera/inspection controls are retained. Patient text is displayed by the Med-AI host, never sent to the iframe or an external viewer.
